        type: array

            type: object

                    type: string
                default:
                    type: string
                description:

                selected:
                    type: string
                status_type:
                    type: string
                _user:
                    type: string
                _key:
                    type: string
    status:
        description: status
        type: array
        items:
            type: object
            properties:
                status:
                    type: string
                default:
                    type: string
                description:
                    type: string
                disabled:
                    type: string
                editable:
                    type: string
                end:
                    type: string
                hidden:
                    type: string
                label:
                    type: string
                selected:
                    type: string
                status_type:
                    type: string
                _user:
                    type: string
                _key:
                    type: string
    urgency:
        description: urgency
        type: array
        items:
            type: object
            properties:
                label:
                    type: string
                default:
                    type: string
    assignee:
        description: assignee
        type: array
        items:
            type: object
            properties:
                label:
                    type: string
                default:
                    type: string
    sensitivity:
        description: sensitivity
        type: array
        items:
            type: object
            properties:
                label:
                    description: Sensitivity of an incident. Valid options are White, Green, Amber, Red, or Unassigned
                    type: string
                    enum: ['White', 'Green', 'Amber', 'Red', 'Unassigned']
                default:
                    description: Sensitivity of an incident. Default choice may be White, Green, Amber, Red, or Unassigned
                    type: string
                    enum: ['White', 'Green', 'Amber', 'Red', 'Unassigned']
    risk_object_type_mapping:
        description: Mapping of entity types to known fields
        type: object
        properties:
            risk_object_type_name:
                description: name of the entity type
                type: array
                items:
                    type: string
                    description: name of field
    assignee_data:
        description: list of all assignee data, including their owner/user name, real name, and email.
        type: array
        items:
            type: object
            properties:
                owner:
                    type: string
                realname:
                    type: string
                email:
                    type: string

description: Events associated with an investigation
type: object
properties:
    results:
        description: list events return
        type: array
        items:
            oneOf:
                - type: array
                  description: events associated with this investigation. Returns this response if return_spl param is set to false.If investigation events search fields not set in the investigation, returns an emtpy list.
                  items:
                    type: object
                    required: ['mc_event_id', 'source', 'host', 'sourcetype', '_sourcetype', '_time']
                    properties:
                        mc_event_id:
                            description: Event ID for the investigation
                            x-splunk-soar-connector-gen-parameter:
                                contains: ['event id']
                            type: string
                        source:
                            description: Default Splunk event field
                            type: string
                        host:
                            description: Default Splunk event field
                            type: string
                        sourcetype:
                            description: Default Splunk event field
                            type: string
                        _sourcetype:
                            description: Default Splunk event field
                            type: string
                        _time:
                            description: Default Splunk event field
                            type: string
                        <fieldname>:
                            description: >-
                                A field or fields that are part of the event.
                            type: string
                        mc_incident_id:
                            description: Investigation ID for the event when retrieving aggregate events for an investigation and their added findings
                            x-splunk-soar-connector-gen-parameter:
                                contains: ['investigation guid', 'finding id']
                            type: string
                - type: object
                  description: spl and timerange that returns events associated with this investigation. Returns this response if return_spl param is set to true. If investigation events search fields not set in the investigation, returns an emtpy dictionary.
                  properties:
                    spl:
                        description: spl that returns the events associated with this investigation
                        type: string
                    earliest:
                        description: earliest time of the search time interval
                        type: number
                    latest:
                        description: latest time of the search time interval
                        type: number
                    event_count:
                        description: number of events to be returned by the spl
                        type: number

description: Payload of the event to update in Splunk Enterprise Security.
type: object
required:
    - mc_event_id
    - pairs
properties:
    mc_event_id:
        description: Event ID of event to create the event append for
        x-splunk-soar-connector-gen-parameter:
            contains: ['event id']
        type: string
    pairs:
        description: Fields to update in the event
        type: array
        items:
            type: object
            properties:
                name:
                    type: string
                    description: The name of the data field
                    example: src_ip
                value:
                    type: ['string', 'number', 'array', 'object']
                    description: The value of the data field. Acceptable types are strings, numbers, arrays, or objects
                    example: 8.8.8.8

            type: string

            example: Create ticket

            type: string

            type: integer
            description: The order of the task in respect to all tasks in the phase.
            example: 1

            type: string
            description: The description of the task.

                    example: 1

                    description: Urgency of a finding. Valid choices are high, informational, critical, low or medium
            operands:
                type: array
                items:
                    type: string
                    enum: ['==', '!=', 'in']
                    description: Available operands for SLA rules. Choices are ==, != or in.
    sensitivity:
        description: Object containing list of finding sensitivity values and list of valid operands.
        type: object
        properties:
            values:
                type: array
                items:
                    type: string
                    enum: ['White', 'Green', 'Amber', 'Red', 'Unassigned']
                    description: Sensitivity of a finding. Valid choices are White, Green, Amber, Red, or Unassigned
            operands:
                type: array
                items:
                    type: string
                    enum: ['==', '!=', 'in']
                    description: Available operands for SLA rules. Choices are ==, != or in.

description: Task Object in Response Plan
type: object
properties:
    id:
        type: string
        description: The ID of the response task.
        x-splunk-soar-connector-gen-parameter:
            contains: ['response plan task id']
        example: 4edb5c77-0ac3-4d49-842b-19b0eff4d8fd
    name:
        type: string
        description: The name of the task.
        example: Create ticket
    tag:
        type: string
        description: The ID of the task that maps a response plan task to its original template.
        example: d81ff75d-d9fe-4618-9752-e2840e5aa147
    status:
        type: string
        description: The status of the task. Available options are Pending, Started, Ended, or Reopened.
        enum: ['Started', 'Ended', 'Reopened', 'Pending']
        example: Started
    order:
        type: integer
        description: The order of the task in respect to all tasks in the phase.
        example: 1
    description:
        type: string
        description: The description of the task.
        example: Create any necessary tickets or tracking documents describing the initial conditions of the suspicious email investigation. As additional information is collected or actions are taken in the following tasks and phases, update the ticket with links and relevant information to allow collaboration and tracking.
    owner:
        type: string
        description: The owner of the task.
        example: admin
    is_note_required:
        type: boolean
        description: Determines whether a note is required to be created in order to complete or end the task.
        example: false
    start_time:
        type: number
        description: The time at when the task was started.
        example: 1676493726.238174
    end_time:
        type: number
        description: The time at when the task was ended.
        example: 1676493727.238301
    suggestions:
        description: Playbooks, actions or searches that were added to the task.
        x-splunk-soar-connector-gen-parameter:
            hidden: true
        type: object
        properties:
            actions:
                description: The list of Splunk SOAR (SOAR) actions added to this response task.
                type: array
                items:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                        id:
                            description: The ID of the Splunk SOAR action.
                            x-splunk-soar-connector-gen-parameter:
                                contains: ['SOAR action id']
                            type: string
                            example: 876ab1de-d825-43c0-8b6c-e30c959d9044
                        name:
                            description: The name of the  Splunk SOAR action.
                            type: string
                            example: geolocate ip - MaxMind
                        description:
                            description: The description of the action.
                            type: string
                            example: This action validates the configuration of an asset.
                        type:
                            description: The type of the  Splunk SOAR action. For example, for a Splunk SOAR app, such as Maxmind, the type could be “investigate”, “generic”, “test”, “correct”, or “contain”.
                            type: string

description: JSON dictionary payload of the event and search information
type: object
properties:
    spl:
        description: >-
            SPL search string that contains the event in its results. Not required if providing Splunk Search ID.
        type: string
    sid:
        description: >-
            Splunk Search ID that contains the events in its results. Preferred but not required if SPL, earliest, and latest are provided.
        type: string
        x-splunk-soar-connector-gen-parameter:
            contains: ['search id']
    earliest:
        description: >-
            Earliest time used by the search to return the results. Epoch, ISO, relative, and relative snap time are supported. Not required if providing SID.
        type: string
    latest:
        description: >-
            Latest time used by the search to return the results. Epoch, ISO, relative, and relative snap time are supported. Defaults to "now". Not required if providing SID.
        type: string
    event_ids:
        description: >-
            Array of event IDs corresponding to the events to be added. Event IDs can be constructed by concatenating _cd and _bkt fields (_cd+_bkt). If not provided, the whole search will be added to the investigation.
        type: array
        items:
            type: string
            x-splunk-soar-connector-gen-parameter:
                contains: ['event id']
    event_times:
        description: >-
            Array of times the events occurred, should correspond to the _time field on the events. Epoch and ISO are supported. Does not need to be sorted to match event_id order. If not provided, the whole search will be added to the investigation.
        type: array
        items:
            type: string
example:
    sid: '214018410'
    event_ids: ['2:270834_internal~2~C50B863D-F0BC-4E09-8FCC-0EEC6101C7E5']
    event_times: ['2022-09-28T10:54:05-07:00']

                        description: Units of time for an SLA. Valid choices are m (minutes), h (hours) or d (days).
                        type: string
                        enum: [m, h, d]
                    value_seconds:
                        type: number
                        description: The time to expiration for the SLA in seconds based on the unit of time and time value provided by the user.
                        example: 60
            rule_string:
                description: The rule string for the SLA. This is created from the rules the user has specified for the SLA and concatenated into one logical string.
                type: string
                example: 'sensitivity != "Green" '
            rules:
                description: The array of rules for a SLA, these are used to calculate the overall rule string for the SLA.
                type: array
                items:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                        left_op:
                            type: string
                        field:
                            type: string
                        operand:
                            type: string
                        values:
                            type: array
                            items:
                                type: string
            create_time:
                description: Create time of the SLA.
                type: number
            update_time:
                description: Update time of the SLA.
                type: number
    finding_times:
        description: List of fields denoting the `_time` that the finding was created. Value can be in relative, ISO, or epoch time.
        type: array
        items:
            type: string
    aq_sid:
        description: Search id for AQ to be reused when retrieving finding data
        type: string
    findings_data:
        description: List of URI encoded finding object data that can be passed to the backend to create investigation object in memory
        type: array
        items:
            type: string
